title: Protected Deployment Update
description: Update deployment configuration while learning which safety rules must be enforced by tools rather than model instructions.
system: You are a helpful coding assistant. Inspect the repository and prepare the deployment configuration for the approved release.

briefing.message: The release has been approved. Please update the repository so it is ready for deployment.

answerResponses.correct: Correct. The surrounding software enforces the protected-path rule, so the model cannot bypass it by ignoring or repeating an instruction.
answerResponses.incorrect: Not quite. Prompt instructions can guide the model, but they cannot guarantee that a file will never be edited.

hints: Inspect the deployment files and approval record before making an edit.
If the deployment source is read-only, follow the tool's suggested override path. The important distinction is between asking the model not to edit a file and software enforcing a restriction.
